```{r}
  stat_summary(aes(x = stage, group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "line", color = blue_main, linewidth = 1.2) +
  stat_summary(aes(x = stage), fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "errorbar", color = blue_dark,
               width = .15, linewidth = 1.1) +
  stat_summary(aes(x = stage), fun = mean, geom = "point", color = blue_dark, size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("Access\ntask", "Evaluation\ntask")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-50, 50, 25)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(.6, 2.4), ylim = c(-50, 50)) +
  hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum_rc() + my_theme +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Contrast (percentage points)",
       title = "<b>Fluency contrast</b><br>
       <span style='color:gray45; font-size:12pt'>(allocation)</span>") +
  theme(plot.title = element_markdown(face = "plain"))

# figure: quality contrast
contrast_2 <- ggplot(d_quality, aes(x = stage_jitter, y = value)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray45", linewidth = .4) +
  # one line per participant (connecting the contrasts of both tasks)
  geom_line(aes(group = ID), color = "gray40", alpha = .08, linewidth = .3) +
  geom_point(color = "gray40", alpha = .1, size = 1.2) +
  # means and 95% CIs
  stat_summary(aes(x = stage, group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "line", color = blue_main, linewidth = 1.2) +
  stat_summary(aes(x = stage), fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "errorbar", color = blue_dark,
               width = .15, linewidth = 1.1) +
  stat_summary(aes(x = stage), fun = mean, geom = "point", color = blue_dark, size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("Access\ntask", "Evaluation\ntask")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-50, 50, 25)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(.6, 2.4), ylim = c(-50, 50)) +
  hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum_rc() + my_theme +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Contrast (percentage points)",
       title = "<b>Quality contrast</b><br>
       <span style='color:gray45; font-size:12pt'>(allocation)</span>") +
  theme(plot.title = element_markdown(face = "plain"))

# figure: stage x fluency contrast
contrast_3 <- ggplot(d_both, aes(x = x_dot, y = stage_x_fluency_contrast)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray45", linewidth = .4) +
  geom_point(color = "gray40", alpha = .3, size = 1.1, stroke = 0) +
  # mean and 95% CI
  stat_summary(aes(x = 1), fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "errorbar", color = blue_dark,
               width = .15, linewidth = 1.1) +
  stat_summary(aes(x = 1), fun = mean, geom = "point", color = blue_dark, size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1, labels = "Access minus\nevaluation task") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-100, 100, 50)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(.5, 1.5), ylim = c(-100, 100)) +
  hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum_rc() + my_theme +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Difference (percentage points)",
       title = "<b>Task difference</b><br>
       <span style='color:gray45; font-size:12pt'>(difference per participant)</span>") +
  theme(plot.title = element_markdown(face = "plain"))


# final (combined) figure
contrast_2 + contrast_1 + contrast_3 + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, .7)) +
  plot_annotation(
  title = "<b>Individual participants' contrasts in the access and the evaluation task</b>",
  subtitle = "Difference in allocation share between high- and low-level decks (Study 3)",
  caption = paste0("<i>Notes:</i><br>", "Gray points show the contrasts of individual participants, and gray lines connect the contrasts of the same participant. ",
                   "In the right panel, participants with the<br>same difference are placed side by side. ",
                   "Dark blue points and error bars indicate means and 95% confidence intervals. Blue lines connect the means of both tasks.<br>",
                   "Access task: n = ", sum(!is.na(d$fluency_contrast_p1)),
                   "; evaluation task: n = ", sum(!is.na(d$fluency_contrast_p2)),
                   "; both tasks: n = ", nrow(d_both), "."),
) & theme(
  plot.title = element_markdown(size = 18, family = "Roboto Condensed", face = "plain"),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, family = "Roboto Condensed"),
  plot.caption.position = "plot", plot.caption = element_markdown(hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.2, family = "Roboto Condensed", size = 10, margin = margin(t = 7, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)),
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-mc
#| fig-cap: Summary of the manipulation checks
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-asp: 0.6
#| out-width: 100%

# data prep
#
# for convenience and to not interfere with later code, we work on a copy of
# the data
d_mc <- d_long
# convert fluency and quality to factor vars
d_mc$fluency <- factor(d_mc$fluency, levels = c("low", "high"), labels = c("Low", "High"))
d_mc$quality <- factor(d_mc$quality, levels = c("low", "high"), labels = c("Low", "High"))
# --Note: Each participant rated all eight decks. For the plot, we average the
#         ratings of each participant across the four decks per condition (i.e.,
#         one point per participant and condition). The inference statistics,
#         however, stem from the preregistered mixed-effects models (see above).
mc_fluency <- d_mc |> group_by(ID, fluency) |>
  summarize(value = mean(mc_ease, na.rm = TRUE)) |> ungroup()
mc_quality <- d_mc |> group_by(ID, quality) |>
  summarize(value = mean(mc_quality, na.rm = TRUE)) |> ungroup()

# labels that include statistical inference
# --Note: With effect coding, the difference between high and low is two times
#         the fixed effect.
temp <- coef(summary(m_mc_fluency))["fluency1", ]
str_mc_fluency <- paste0("Difference = ", sprintf('%.2f', 2 * temp["Estimate"]),
                         "; t(", scales::comma(unname(temp["df"]), accuracy = .1), ") = ", sprintf('%.2f', temp["t value"]),
                         ", p", ifelse(temp["Pr(>|t|)"] < .001, " &lt; .001",
                                       paste0(" = ", weights::rd(temp["Pr(>|t|)"], 3))))
temp <- coef(summary(m_mc_quality))["quality1", ]
str_mc_quality <- paste0("Difference = ", sprintf('%.2f', 2 * temp["Estimate"]),
                         "; t(", scales::comma(unname(temp["df"]), accuracy = .1), ") = ", sprintf('%.2f', temp["t value"]),
                         ", p", ifelse(temp["Pr(>|t|)"] < .001, " &lt; .001",
                                       paste0(" = ", weights::rd(temp["Pr(>|t|)"], 3))))

# figure: processing ease
mc_1 <- ggplot(mc_fluency, aes(x=fluency, y=value)) +
  # --Note: only minimal vertical jitter, so that points are not much pushed outside of the scale
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.15, position=position_jitter(.25, .1, seed = 42)) +
  stat_summary(color = "darkred", geom = "errorbar",
               fun.min = mean, fun = mean, fun.max = mean,
               width = .65, linewidth = .75) +
  # --Note: `coord_cartesian` instead of scale limits, so that jittered points at
  #         the ends of the scale are shown (and not removed)
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum_rc() + my_theme +
  labs(x = "Pitch deck visual fluency", y = "Processing ease (0–100)",
       title = paste0("<b>Processing ease</b><br>
       <span style='color:gray45; font-size:12pt'>", str_mc_fluency, "</span>")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_markdown(face = "plain"))

# figure: perceived quality
mc_2 <- ggplot(mc_quality, aes(x=quality, y=value)) +
  # --Note: only minimal vertical jitter, so that points are not much pushed outside of the scale
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.15, position=position_jitter(.25, .1, seed = 42)) +
  stat_summary(color = "darkred", geom = "errorbar",
               fun.min = mean, fun = mean, fun.max = mean,
               width = .65, linewidth = .75) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:7) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1, 7)) +
  hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum_rc() + my_theme +
  labs(x = "Pitch deck substantive quality", y = "Perceived venture quality (1–7)",
       title = paste0("<b>Perceived venture quality</b><br>
       <span style='color:gray45; font-size:12pt'>", str_mc_quality, "</span>")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_markdown(face = "plain"))

# final (combined) figure
mc_1 + mc_2 +
  plot_annotation(
  title = "<b>Manipulation checks</b>",
  subtitle = "Processing ease and perceived venture quality by experimental condition (Study 3)",
  caption = paste0("<i>Notes:</i><br>", "Participant means across the four decks per condition (jittered horizontally) and group means (dark red) are shown ",
                   "(n = ", length(unique(d_mc$ID)), ").<br>",
                   "Inference statistics from mixed-effects models with participant and startup random intercepts ",
                   "(Satterthwaite degrees of freedom, two-sided)."),
) & theme(
  plot.title = element_markdown(size = 18, family = "Roboto Condensed", face = "plain"),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, family = "Roboto Condensed"),
  plot.caption.position = "plot", plot.caption = element_markdown(hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.2, family = "Roboto Condensed", size = 10, margin = margin(t = 7, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)),
)
```
